takes.title: Walk Out, Turn, and Continue Walking
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts mid-stride, walks with a loose arm swing, turns through profile, and continues away through the end.

takes.title: Alternate Compact Hand Signals and Pauses
takes.actionDescription: From a staggered stance, the performer repeats short gestures near the chest and face with upright pauses between them. The CMU source describes basketball signals.

takes.title: Act Out a Teapot Rhyme with an Overhead Reach
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens the hands to the sides, places one hand near the hip, and raises the other arm. They lean sideways with a low reach before standing to finish.

takes.title: Act Out a Teapot Rhyme with a Low Side Reach
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens both arms, alternates a hand at the hip with a high raised arm, then bends sideways with one hand out low. They straighten and finish with arms relaxed.

takes.title: Gesture at Chest Height and Open Both Arms
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens with arms in front, alternates one-handed gestures near the chest and face with a wide two-arm sweep, and finishes in profile with both forearms forward.

takes.title: Alternate Side Reaches and Hand-to-Face Gestures
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with one hand low and forward, opens the arms, and repeats smaller hand-to-face and upward gestures. They finish in profile with one arm extended.

takes.title: Act Out a Rhyme with Changes in Reach Height
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens with both hands raised, alternates forward reaches, a deep lean, and hand-to-face gestures across several upright pauses. The arms return to the sides at the end.

takes.title: Act Out a Rhyme with Alternating One-Hand Signals
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts standing and repeatedly lifts one hand, brings it toward the chest, then extends it out to the side. The arms lower before the final stance.

takes.title: Squat to Pick Up from One Side
takes.actionDescription: From standing, the performer lowers into a deep squat and reaches down to one side, holds briefly, then rises and finishes upright.

takes.title: Crouch to Lift, Then Straighten
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, crouches deeply with the hands near the floor, and straightens while drawing the hands upward. They finish in an upright stance turned slightly aside.

takes.title: Bend at the Waist to Lift from the Floor
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, folds forward with both hands low, then straightens while lifting one arm. They finish standing with both arms lowered.
